verdict.rationale: GitHub Actions is confirmed as GitHub's CI/CD offering (github-docs-11), but the evidence pack contains no documentation of an organization-wide dashboard, reporting, or centralized visibility feature for workflow runs across repos/teams. Community evidence even notes recurring Actions outages/reliability issues (github-comm-18) rather than confirming visibility tooling. Missing for 10: org-level Actions insights/dashboard docs, cross-repo workflow run reporting, audit-log or analytics integration for CI/CD, and independent confirmation of such visibility working at scale.
